title: Frequency identification of density
source: The same two-element consistent axial rod has frequencies proportional to 1/sqrt(rho) at fixed E. Its determinant is 7 lambda^2 - 240000 lambda + 576000000 for E=1000 Pa, rho=1 kg/m^3, h=0.5 m; the base frequencies are 8.110128166520553 Hz and 28.331839147600448 Hz. The observations are those values divided by sqrt(1.44).

quantities.reason: Both observations are the closed-form frequencies at rho=1.44 kg/m³, because frequency scales as rho^(-1/2).
With independent 0.01 Hz errors, sigma_rho=0.00117272720839326 kg/m³; the endpoint is rho-1.959963984540054 sigma_rho.
The same independent-error linearization gives rho+1.959963984540054 sigma_rho.
